page.title: Recent errors
page.help: System errors members saw a Ref for, and errors in background tasks. Grouped by error code and source, newest first (at most 50 groups).

kept: Errors kept: {count} (the newest {max} are kept; at most 30 are recorded per minute).
privacy: No user IDs and no text written by members are stored; IDs in error messages are masked.

unavailable.title: Database unavailable
unavailable.text: The error list could not be read because the database is not responding. Try again in a few minutes.
